newsitem.title: USA: Delta Feb load factor 67.39 pct vs 65.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Delta Feb load factor 67.39 pct vs 65.50 pct.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc Friday said its system load factor for February 1997 was 67.39 percent, compared with 65.50 percent in February 1996.
Calendar year-to-date system load factor was 65.77 percent versus 63.65 percent, the company said.
February systemwide available seat miles increased 4.6 percent to 10.474 billion against 10.011 billion in 1996.
Revenue passenger miles, or RPMs, totaled 7.058 billion during February, a 7.6 percent increase from 6.055 billion a year ago.
For the calendar year-to-date, Delta's traffic grew 10.5 percent to 14.456 billion RPMs, while capacity increased 7.0 percent to 21.982 billion ASMs, the company said.
